name: Kadrak
summary: At the Mor'shan Rampart, Kadrak guards the northern frontier between the Barrens and Ashenvale. He directs dispatches and reinforcements into the contested forest, where the Horde fights the night elves.

sections.title: Guardian of the Rampart
sections.body: At the Mor'shan Rampart, Kadrak guards the main route between the Barrens and Ashenvale. The barricade marks a hard border: Horde-held plains lie to the south, and night elf-guarded woods stretch north. Kadrak keeps watch against Sentinels and hostile woodland creatures, holding the perimeter against incursions.

sections.title: Frontline Logistics
sections.body: Kadrak also handles military reports between the Barrens and logging camps deeper in Ashenvale. Couriers bring him combat reports from the Warsong Outriders, and he directs supplies and reinforcements to outposts such as Splintertree Post. Those who report to Kadrak are sent onward into the struggle for the forest.

aliases: who is the orc at the wall
faq.answer: Kadrak is an orc officer at the Mor'shan Rampart. He oversees the border and directs Horde forces traveling between the Barrens and the fighting in Ashenvale.
Kadrak can be found at the Mor'shan Rampart, a fortified wooden barricade at the northern edge of the Barrens, where the road leads into Ashenvale.

faq.q: What is Kadrak's role in the Horde?
faq.answer: Kadrak commands the border defenses and gathers military reports from scout runners. He briefs Horde travelers heading north to reinforce outposts such as Splintertree Post.

faq.q: Why is the Mor'shan Rampart heavily defended?
faq.answer: The Mor'shan Rampart guards the northern approaches to the Barrens and Durotar against night elf incursions in response to the Horde's logging operations in Ashenvale.

faq.q: What quests does Kadrak provide or complete?
faq.answer: Kadrak receives reports carried from the Barrens and sends adventurers on assignments involving Warsong scouting reports and strengthening the Horde presence along the forest frontier.

faq.q: Does Kadrak have ties to other notable Horde figures?
faq.answer: Kadrak keeps in regular contact with the Warsong Outriders in Ashenvale and receives their scouting reports at the Rampart.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can look to Kadrak to direct warriors north to defend lumber operations and claim Horde territory in Ashenvale.
If you fight for the Alliance and try to enter the Barrens from Ashenvale, Kadrak's rampart blocks the road into the Horde heartland.
As an orc, you can see Kadrak's defense of the Ashenvale border as part of the Warsong Clan's effort to claim territory.
As a warrior, you know the discipline it takes to hold a fortified choke point against woodland fighters and guerrilla raids.
